summary.headline: Apomasar’s Second Book Index
summary.text: Chapter list from the second book of the mysteries of Apomasar, covering fugitives, rain, longevity, metals, journeys threatened by robbers, royal nativities, truth-telling, prophetic religion, rebellion, and long planetary conjunctions. Authorities and manuscript references include Apomasar, Sadan, codex Bononiensis 18, and codex Venetus 5.
